purpose: M13 prespecified follow-up to a post-hoc SENSITIVITY boundary cell; no externally preregistered or independently selected boundary claim
cohort: MATCHED boundary k sweep, local Ubuntu WSL fallback after recorded authorized-server SSH timeout
generation: Unchanged SENSITIVITY generate_degree: Gaussian corpus vectors then two relation layers with 8 uniform successors per vertex except n-1; retain multiedges; anchor=(seed*7919+37)%(n-1); Gaussian query mt19937(seed*1697+h). One graph/predicate/query vector reused across all six k values.

timing.order: seed ascending; k ascending; one warmup in method-list order; each measured repetition uses original deterministic shuffled method order mt19937(seed*10007+query_id*19+rep)
timing.include: fresh request allocations and every operation in the unchanged execute kernel
timing.exclude: graph/vector generation, oracle, CSV writes, diagnostic root trace, returned answer destruction
timing.coordination: Only experiments subagent executes timed experiments; no other formal benchmark overlaps
timing.no_pooling: Do not pool MATCHED absolute times with NATIVE or SENSITIVITY. k1/10/100 are remeasured within this cohort.
timing.limitations: WSL virtual CPU affinity does not enforce exclusive physical-core ownership or stable frequency; k order not randomized.

exactness: Original independent flat-edge membership oracle and scalar distance/identifier ranking contract. Every warmup and timed result checked; mismatch aborts. Original 7776 exact tests plus 324 small-graph checks including the new k, empty anchor and all-zero ties.
diagnostics: Untimed per-root shared reverse traversal after all k timings for each seed: first eligible rank, first-root dependency closure, new/cumulative edge and state counts. Exact sorted truth checked at every requested k. FNV64 fingerprints are noncryptographic invariant fingerprints; SHA256 used for artifact integrity.

planned_analysis.per_configuration: median of three repetitions per method; retain all ten seeds, including losses
planned_analysis.paired_ratio: LazyShared median divided by min(ForwardTopK median,ReverseRecursiveTopK median), paired within seed and k
planned_analysis.bootstrap: 10000 percentile bootstrap resamples of ten seed clusters with RNG seed 20261025; the same seed resample indexes are used for all k; report median paired ratio and ratio to k1 changes
planned_analysis.first_repetition: retain all three methods and counters for all ten k1 seeds, for both historical SENSITIVITY and new MATCHED; never pool historical times
planned_analysis.plot: Left: SENSITIVITY k1 all ten seed Lazy/Forward ratios versus lazy edge count with seed labels. Right: MATCHED all six k values and all ten seed Lazy/best-materializer ratios plus paired median/cluster CI and ratio=1 line.
invariants: 540 unique rows; 60 configurations; 180 plan cells; repeats 0,1,2
exact flags all one and positive times
graph/predicate/eligible set/vector/query fingerprints fixed across k within seed
Forward/Reverse graph counters invariant across k; Lazy prefix counters monotone in k
Lazy root_checks equal exact kth eligible rank; trace counters equal raw measured counters
SENSITIVITY anchor k1/10/100 membership and deterministic counters match unchanged generator/kernels

interpretation: First eligible rank and dependency-closure work are outcome diagnostics, not pre-query free inputs; a selectivity estimate alone is not a threshold or sufficient trigger. Report empirical k-specific wins without generalizing finite-grid disappearance.
